name: Hermes Agent's Desktop app can now be served to any browser from your own host
title: Hermes Agent's Desktop app can now be served to any browser from your own host
summary: A merged 'hermes webapp' change serves Hermes Desktop (chat, files, git, a persistent terminal and remote sign-in) to any browser from a machine you host. Teknium says it is available now on the main release channel. Because the web UI includes a terminal, anyone who exposes it beyond localhost should put it behind authentication.
